_readme: Utility tagging is rule-based: county default, then NYC ZIP overrides applied lot by lot. Rebate amounts here are reference notes only and must never be hardcoded into the UI.

coned.note: Residential (1-4 family) Clean Heat. Up to ~$10k ASHP; full amount requires removing or disabling the fossil system; higher in DAC tracts. Participating contractor required.

psegli.note: PSEG LI administers NYS Clean Heat on Long Island as one whole-house rebate, tiered by income (60% / 80% AMI). DAC rate eligibility also exists.
